objective: Test whether lagged breadth and relative momentum of a fixed, interpretable basket of current core constituents/industry-chain leaders adds point-in-time information for future ETF returns beyond the ETF's own lagged momentum.
method_note: Static representative baskets are fixed using publicly disclosed 2026-06-30 top holdings. They are equal-weighted for research and are not historical constituent reconstructions. Results therefore carry survivorship/constituent-lookback bias and are screening evidence only; they cannot be promoted to decision evidence without a later PIT historical-membership validation and share-flow control.
